player_prompt.intro:
I ye jɛgɛ {player_id} ({piece}). Jɛgɛda ye ({opp}). Sɔnɛ ka bɔ kɛ '[b1 c3]' (kɔrɔ → kɔ). Jɛgɛ bɛɛ bɔ kɛ cɛɛ kaba.
Kɔlɔn kɔlɔn bɛ {score_per_capture} pɔɲɛ. Jɛgɛ bɛɛ kɔrɔ {max_moves} bɔ kɔrɔ wa jɛgɛda tɛ sɔnɛ kɛ / jɛgɛ tɛ. Pɔɲɛ caman bɛ sɔrɔ.
